title: Summarise a Terraform plan and gate what auto-applies
acceptanceCriteria: No-op changes and data-source reads add nothing to the summary
A replacement counts as one add and one destroy, never as a change
Every change that carries `importing` counts once under `import`, whatever its actions
`needsApproval` is true whenever any change's actions include `delete`, and false otherwise
Every sample plan's summary matches the `Plan:` line Terraform printed for it
